craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of proclamation — the hammer now proclaims: breath demoted → rest unfolds → Māyā named → mother proclaimed → fence → double-held VERDICT. Demotion hammer; end-weight straying walks (bhrama enacted, not labeled). Rejected: (a) delusion (L2) → killed: L3 frozen + straying walks. (b) softening never → killed: demotion is total. Read aloud: UN-proved BY-nev-er-SPREAD-ing — … ELSE, STRAY-ing.

lines: Unproved by never spreading — though knowing-clad and all —
breath and kin rank knowable, never knower. Else, straying.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na siddho 'prathanād eva jñānādisamavāyy api tat prāṇādi prameyaṃ syān na pramātānyato bhramāt

reads_against.argmap: Can breath and kin be the knower? → Breath is demoted to knowable: the knower cannot be what never spreads.
c1_essence: Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).

Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).
